description: Send a message to Matt Turley (Continuum) on the user's behalf, like the contact form on uxcontinuum.com. Use it when the user wants to ask Matt something or describe a project but not book a call yet. Only send what the user asked to send, with their real name and email. Matt reads it and replies personally by email; no automated reply is sent. For a time to talk, use get_availability and book_call instead.

email.description: The user's own email, for Matt to reply to.

topic.description: Short subject, e.g. "rescue a Lovable app".

name: send_message
title: Send Matt a message
